clientSeedGenerator.A: "audit" + 6 bytes of crypto.getRandomValues as hex (browser CSPRNG)

meta.stakeFiatRule: every round's served fiatCurrency = stakeFiat ('USD' also passes a round not fiat-staked when the wallet currency is USDT / USDC); otherwise the run stops after that round

balanceCheck.read: GET /api/v1/user/get-user, the meta.stakeCurrency wallet amount (the blackjack runner's read)
balanceCheck.before: provably-fair/active shows no game open, then one read immediately before place-bet
balanceCheck.after: after the settle reply (cash-out or the mine): provably-fair/active shows no game open, then reads betDelayMs apart until two in a row agree (at most 6)
balanceCheck.stop: a failed read, a game still open after the settle, or a wallet that does not hold still stops the run after that round ('shape')

meta.tileOrderGenerator: crypto.getRandomValues Fisher-Yates over tiles 1..25 per round (rejection-sampled), the first `depth` opened in that order
